title: macOS security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-134.062018: TT-CSIRT Advisory – macOS Security Updates
leadParagraph: Apple has released a security update stating that a vulnerability has been discovered in Xcode for macOS High Sierra where an attacker can bypass security restrictions.
contentHtml:
Apple has released a security update stating that a vulnerability has been discovered in Xcode for macOS High Sierra where an attacker can bypass security restrictions.

This is due to multiple issues existing in versions of git prior to 2.15.2.

Further information on this vulnerability and how it can be mitigated can be found at https://www.cisecurity.org/advisory/a-vulnerability-in-xcode-for-macos-high-sierra-could-allow-for-arbitrary-code-execution_2018-067/
